name: aegis-daily
description: AEGIS DAILY — the trade journal procedure, in its own plugin. /daily is the one scheduled command: (1) close the book via PTJ and push the journal to GitHub, (2) print the trade journal on screen and prove it is filed on main, (3) print and file the portfolio journal (D-114: day-by-day Aegis NAV with WTD/MTD/QTD/YTD as NAV change) and the trade journal (D-115: every broker fill, FIFO round-trips with entry/exit/qty/fees/net P&L/days/R, open lots, Aegis stats, reconciliation findings). Also carries /ptj (VIEW, FA, CLOSE), print-trade-journal, and /premarket (the post-AQE data prep that gates /pma). Cowork is the runtime, GitHub is storage. Deterministic tools only — no voices, no committee, no orders, and it never triggers AQE.

changes: Trade journal renders AEGIS ONLY (PM ruling): closed trades, open positions and the fills behind them. Non-Aegis names and option legs stay in the raw fill store solely for FIFO matching and never print, count, or flag.

D-115 trade journal: new tools/trade_journal.py (PTJ CLOSE jobs 10.8-10.9). Every broker fill ever pulled is kept in data/persistent/trade_journal.json keyed by the broker's fill id (idempotent); stock round-trips built by FIFO — date in, entry, qty, date out, exit, gross, fees, net, %, days held, R where the stop at entry is known; open lots; Aegis-only stats; reconciliation against the latest journal's positions and the archive ledger, reported as findings. Positions older than the first saved pull are seeded from the earliest journal that carried them, flagged on the row. Seeded from 153 fills back to 2026-08-12.

First reconciliation findings recorded for the PM: the archive booked HNGE 31-Aug off the post-re-buy average cost (-406.37 vs -630.60 per fills and the broker); IBKR's 1-Sep exit (-887.22) has no sell fill in any saved pull; V (20 sh) is open per the journals with no buy fill on record; the archive is gross of sell commissions. Aegis realised net of all fees per fills: -5,293.48 on 13 trades vs the archive's -5,043.74.

portfolio_ledger.py: close dates now derived from when each journal was built (US/Eastern) rather than its label — journals through 2026-09-03 were labelled with the close date, from 2026-09-04 with the next trading day; the build timestamp is true under both. Re-seeded.
/daily Stage 3 prints both ledgers and every reconciliation line verbatim, then confirms both are on main.

D-114 portfolio journal: new tools/portfolio_ledger.py (PTJ CLOSE jobs 10.6-10.7) appends one row per close to data/persistent/portfolio_ledger.json — Aegis NAV (= dynCap, never the co-mingled Tiger NAV), realised, unrealised, exposure, risk — and recomputes WTD/MTD/QTD/YTD/inception as NAV change with realised split out and the baseline named, plus an ISO-week table and the last ten closes, rendered to data/eod/DATE/portfolio_stats_DATE.md. Seeded from the 14 real journals back to the 2026-08-18 close. /daily Stage 3 prints it and confirms it is on main.

All AQE-trigger instructions removed from this plugin (PM ruling 2026-09-06). The Cowork connector cannot call the GitHub Actions API; the AQE daily pipeline runs from its own Claude Code routine. /daily, /ptj and /premarket never dispatch, poll or wait on it.
premarket Step 0 stays idempotent: if phase_gate reads premarket_data READY for the day, /daily already closed the book and the close is skipped.
New plugin. /ptj and /premarket moved out of aegis-core; /daily added.
